Thin-rimmed rectangular eyeglasses are worn by a middle-aged adult with an oval face, prominent brow ridge, and receding hairline at the temples. The individual features a straight-dorsumed nose with a rounded tip, medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes with visible under-eye fullness. Permanent creases are present across the forehead and around the eyes. The lower face is wide with a defined, slightly rounded jawline and a rounded, moderately projecting chin. The subject is dressed in a patterned collared shirt and a dark jacket.
